RedSpotPaintVarnishCoInc.desc: Red Spot is a global leader of high-performance coatings for the automotive, appliance, and cosmetics industries, headquartered right here in Evansville, Indiana since 1903. You will find Red Spot coatings on just about every Ford car and truck produced in North America. We employ around 230 individuals in Evansville for jobs such as production technicians, maintenance technicians, chemists, sales and other administrative roles.  Come grow with us!
RedSpotPaintVarnishCoInc.name: Red Spot Paint & Varnish Co., Inc.

RoseHulman.desc: Rose-Hulman Institute of Technology is consistently ranked among the nation’s top undergraduate STEM colleges, delivering a strong return on investment from day one. Students collaborate with esteemed faculty in labs and innovation centers equipped with cutting-edge technology—opportunities often reserved for graduate students elsewhere. With nearly 100% career placement for two decades, Rose-Hulman prepares graduates for success and offers a vibrant student experience with a close-knit campus community, nationally recognized competition teams, 20 NCAA Division III sports, 90+ student clubs, and 12 fraternities and sororities.
RoseHulman.name: Rose-Hulman

SIUAviation.desc: SIU School of Aviation is home to a nationally recognized and comprehensive aviation program. What started as a service unit of the university offering flight classes with four airplanes and spare parts has transformed into one of the nation’s leading comprehensive aviation programs with multiple degree programs, a state-of-the-industry facility and more than 600 students.  SIU Aviation offers a comprehensive aviation program offering both undergraduate and graduate degree programs in aviation. We have three different undergraduate majors, including: Aviation Flight Aviation Management Aviation Technologies  In addition, we offer a graduate degree in Aviation Management.
SIUAviation.name: SIU Aviation

SIUCollegeofEngineeringComputingTechnolo.desc: The College of Engineering, Computing, Technology, and Mathematics is one of nine colleges on the campus of Southern Illinois University (SIU) Carbondale located approximately 2 hours west of Evansville.  Surrounded by lakes and parks, Southern Illinois University is one on only 21 universities in the country designated as both Research 1 and an Opportunity University.   Come see what makes us special!
SIUCollegeofEngineeringComputingTechnolo.name: SIU College of Engineering, Computing, Technology, and Mathematics

SMARTLocal20.desc: Local 20 represents workers at several contractors around the Evansville area that perform sheet metal work.  That work includes HVAC install and service, Architectural sheet metal, Testing and Balancing (TABB), Industrial and Specialty sheet metal welding and fabrication.  Our workers can make everything they install.
SMARTLocal20.name: SMART Local 20

SilganClosures.desc: The metal jar lids that Silgan Closures makes you will find on many of the food products in your kitchen pantry. To make these lids we need mechanics, operators, maintenance, quality, forklift drivers, shipping, receiving and electricians. These individuals assist in the manufacturing of ~4 million jar lids per day. Please visit Silgan at the Career Fair!
SilganClosures.name: Silgan Closures

SodexoHealthcare.desc: Sodexo Healthcare offers comprehensive food services, clinical solutions and technologies for superior patient and senior care.
SodexoHealthcare.name: Sodexo Healthcare

SoutheasternIllinoisCollege.desc: Southeastern Illinois college is a Community College located in Harrisburg, Illinois.  SIC has several CTE programs with a couple of unique programs.  Outfitter Wildlife Management is a program to prepare students for a career as a conservation officer, hunting guide, park ranger among other careers in the outdoors.  The Powersports technology program is a one-year certificate program prepares students to repair UTVs, ATVs, jet skis and much more.
SoutheasternIllinoisCollege.name: Southeastern Illinois College

SouthernIllinoisUniversitySchoolofAviati.desc: SIU School of Aviation is home to a nationally recognized and comprehensive aviation program. What started as a service unit of the university offering flight classes with four airplanes and spare parts has transformed into one of the nation’s leading comprehensive aviation programs with multiple degree programs, a state-of-the-industry facility and more than 600 students. The program’s reach now extends nationally with online and Distance Education offerings and internationally with agreements to train aviation technology students. The School of Aviation includes the Aviation Technologies, Aviation Management and Aviation Flight programs.
SouthernIllinoisUniversitySchoolofAviati.name: Southern Illinois University - School of Aviation

SouthwesternIndianaBuildersAssociation.desc: We are an organization of building industry professionals promoting and advocating for safe and affordable housing.
SouthwesternIndianaBuildersAssociation.name: Southwestern Indiana Builders Association

TMIFabricators.desc: TMI Fabricators is a trusted metal fabrication company based in Mount Vernon, Indiana. We specialize in providing high-quality custom fabrication services to meet the needs of industries across the region. Our team combines years of hands-on experience with advanced tools and technology to deliver precision work, whether it’s one-off custom projects or large-scale production. At TMI Fabricators, we take pride in our craftsmanship, reliability, and customer-focused approach—helping our partners bring their projects to life with strength, accuracy, and efficiency.  This approach allows us to fabricate the future together.
TMIFabricators.name: TMI Fabricators

ToyotaMotorManufacturingIndiana.desc: Toyota Motor Manufacturing Indiana (TMMI) is a key player in Toyota's global manufacturing strategy. Located in Princeton, Indiana, the plant is equipped with high-tech systems and employs a combination of human and robotic workers to produce vehicles such as the Grand Highlander, Highlander, and Sienna Hybrid. TMMI's operations include vehicle production, stamping, body welding, paint, and assembly, making it a significant contributor to Toyota's production capabilities.
ToyotaMotorManufacturingIndiana.name: Toyota Motor Manufacturing Indiana

TransportEnterpriseLeasing.desc: Transport Enterprise Leasing (TEL) has been a trusted provider of truck and trailer leasing solutions for over 20 years. With five distinct revenue centers, TEL offers full-service leasing for trucks and trailers, remarketing of off-lease equipment, and comprehensive owner-operator support—including 24/7 breakdown assistance, nationwide maintenance, business services, and risk management. The newest division, Equipment Finance, expands TEL’s capabilities in commercial financing. TEL operates offices and a reconditioning center in Tennessee and Indiana.
TransportEnterpriseLeasing.name: Transport Enterprise Leasing

TriStateOrthopaedicSurgeons.desc: Tri-State Orthopaedics was founded in 1949 by Dr. John H. Sterne and Dr. Henry Leibundguth, and has grown into the largest orthopaedic practice of its kind in the Evansville, Indiana area. Our 37 physicians, advanced practice providers and their affiliated staff carry on our Founders’ commitment to and reputation for excellence, providing specialized orthopaedic care for patients all across the tri-state. Our physician team includes specialists with Fellowship-Training in Sports Medicine, Adult Joint Reconstruction, Arthroscopy, Hand Surgery, Hand Trauma & Reconstructive Surgery, Spine Surgery, Neurosurgery, and Microvascular Surgery.
TriStateOrthopaedicSurgeons.name: Tri-State Orthopaedic Surgeons

TriadFabricators.desc: Triad Fabricators, based in Evansville, Indiana, was formed by consolidating three legacy fabrication shops; Traylor Bros. (founded in 1946), Sterling Industrial (founded in 1982), and Traylor Industrial (founded in 1984).    Our focus is fabrication, which is what we do best, but as part of the Traylor Construction Group, we have the resources to see any project through from concept to completion. With both domestic and international experience, Triad has proven ability on a global scale.
TriadFabricators.name: Triad Fabricators

TrilogyHealthServices.desc: At Trilogy, you’ll find more than a job—you’ll find a community that supports you, challenges you, and helps you grow. With 130+ senior living communities across five states (and more on the way), the possibilities are as endless as your potential.
TrilogyHealthServices.name: Trilogy Health Services

USIKinneyCollegeofNursingandHealthScienc.desc: The Kinney College of Nursing and Health Professions has a global influence in health, healthcare and healthcare education with students from 28 states and six countries enrolled in on-campus and online undergraduate, graduate and doctoral programs.  To ensure our graduates are ready for the challenges of a rapidly changing healthcare delivery system, our educational goals focus on critical thinking and creative problem solving. Additional goals include the use of evidence-based practice protocols, effective communication, cultural sensitivity, systems leadership for quality care and health policy.  Our vision is a simple but powerful one: Healthy communities for all.
USIKinneyCollegeofNursingandHealthScienc.name: USI Kinney College of Nursing and Health Sciences

UniversityofEvansville.desc: The University of Evansville is a private, comprehensive university with a foundation in the arts and sciences as well as the professions where thousands of students have found their home, discovered their passion, and pursued success around the world. I would like to invite you to do the same!
UniversityofEvansville.name: University of Evansville

UniversityofSouthernIndiana.desc: The University of Southern Indiana's appeal to students is found in its size, the accessibility of professors, its beautiful environment and innovative housing, its proximity to an urban center, the friendliness of students, employees and the community, as well as its affordability and value. Founded in 1965, USI enrolls nearly 9,400 dual credit, undergraduate and graduate students in more than 130 areas of study. A public higher education institution, located on a beautiful 1,400-acre campus in Evansville, Indiana, USI offers programs through the College of Liberal Arts, Romain College of Business, Kinney College of Nursing and Health Professions, Pott College of Science, Engineering, and Education, and School of Graduate Studies.
UniversityofSouthernIndiana.name: University of Southern Indiana

UniversityofSouthernIndianaArmyROTC.desc: University of Southern Indiana Army ROTC develops the future leaders of our Nations Army.  We provide ad 4 year on campus development program to make future Army second lieutenants. ROTC offers scholarships and routes for all majors with opportunities for internships and training opportunities.
UniversityofSouthernIndianaArmyROTC.name: University of Southern Indiana Army ROTC

UniversityofSouthernIndianaFoodandNutrit.desc: Kinney College of Nursing and Health Professions Food and Nutrition degree is designed to prepare graduates for entry into community food and nutrition-related careers including healthcare, business, and industry. The major provides a broad coverage of the interpersonal, conceptual, analytical, and application skills necessary to perform in the food and nutrition-related field.   The College offers a Bachelor of Science or Bachelor of Art degree in Food and Nutrition. Students choosing this degree must specialize in Dietetics, Nutrition and Wellness, or Food Service Management.
UniversityofSouthernIndianaFoodandNutrit.name: University of Southern Indiana- Food and Nutrition Department

UniversityofSouthernIndianaHumanResource.desc: USI HR hires for all open positions on campus. We have full-time and part-time positions available. We have departments ranging from office/clerical to maintenace and public safety.
UniversityofSouthernIndianaHumanResource.name: University of Southern Indiana - Human Resources

UsArmyEvansvilleArmyRecruitingOffice.desc: The Army is the largest branch of the military. We have 150 different jobs in several different fields. We have mechanical jobs, medical jobs, I.T. jobs, and several other fields. We offer several benefits for college to attain higher education.
UsArmyEvansvilleArmyRecruitingOffice.name: Us Army Evansville Army Recruiting Office

VUCollegeofTechnology.desc: VU College of Technology has hands on programs. We offer 2 year degrees in Technology which allows students good benefits & high pay. We have work learn base environments that has paid internships while going to school & making money to be little to no debt after their 2 year degree.
VUCollegeofTechnology.name: VU College of Technology

VanderburghCountySheriffsOffice.desc: The Vanderburgh County Sheriff’s Office employs more than 270 sworn deputies, confinement officers, and civilian support personnel among three divisions: Administration, Confinement, and Operations.  We are committed to providing professional law enforcement and community service to our citizens. To maintain our professional standing within our community, we seek qualified individuals with the necessary skills and abilities to perform the essential functions for the operation of our agency.
VanderburghCountySheriffsOffice.name: Vanderburgh County Sheriff's Office

VincennesUniversityAgribusinessHorticult.desc: At Vincennes University, the Agribusiness and Horticulture programs prepare students for a diverse range of careers. Students can earn a bachelor's degree in Agribusiness or an associate's degree in Animal Husbandry, Urban Agriculture, or Landscape Design & Horticulture, along with different certificates. There is a wide range of opportunities that lie within our programs, from multiple hands-on experiences, guest speakers, field trips, and travel. A great to place to engage with other ag professionals!
VincennesUniversityAgribusinessHorticult.name: Vincennes University Agribusiness & Horticulture Department

VincennesUniversityArchitecturalStudiesP.name: Vincennes University - Architectural Studies / Product Design

VincennesUniversityadvancedmanufacturing.desc: Vincennes University's advanced manufacturing robotics and mechatronics program. We are a 2 year degree that has partnerships with multiple companies for internships through the AMT program.
VincennesUniversityadvancedmanufacturing.name: Vincennes University (advanced manufacturing)

WNINTriStatePublicMediaInc.desc: WNIN Tri-State Public Media, Inc. has both TV and Radio public media stations.  We also produce digital content that may be streamed on our website, viewed as a podcast, or posted on various social media channels.  WNIN is a non-profit organization that connects with the community through award winning local programming and a number of special events each year.  We hire student interns to assist our staff in many areas including Multi-Media Production, Radio, Digital/Social Media, Events, and Engineering.  Please visit our website for more information at https://www.wnin.org/.
WNINTriStatePublicMediaInc.name: WNIN Tri-State PublicMedia, Inc.

WOCMaintenance.desc: Our team of certified technicians, who are responsible for the maintenance and repair of all things petroleum, can take care of tank cleanings, pumps, fuel systems, and tank gauging systems. Additionally, our dedicated lift inspectors can address automotive equipment needs.
WOCMaintenance.name: WOC Maintenance

WabashValleyCollege.desc: he PTA program is a two-year associate degree program that prepares you for entry-level employment opportunities in various settings, such as hospitals, clinics, nursing homes, schools, and sports facilities. You will learn the theory and practice of physical therapy, including anatomy, physiology, kinesiology, pathology, therapeutic exercise, modalities, and rehabilitation. You will also gain clinical experience through supervised internships at local facilities.
WabashValleyCollege.name: Wabash Valley College

WabashValleyCollegeRadioTV.desc: A two-year college offering degrees in Radio/TV and Digital Media, Sports Marketing and Media, and Music and Media. Students in these programs operate the college's Radio Station - 89.1 The Bash and TV Channel - News Channel 15. These hands-on programs allow students to gain valuable real-world experience and a fast track entry into the industry.
WabashValleyCollegeRadioTV.name: Wabash Valley College Radio/TV

WesternKentuckyUniversityDepartmentofAgr.desc: The Department of Agriculture & Food Science at WKU prepares students for careers in Agriculture.  Examples of these careers include:  veterinarians, crop consultants, finance, operation managers, animal nutritionist, sports and golf turf managers, florist, landscape designers, horse trainers, and agriculture teachers. Students at WKU focus in the fields of Agribusiness, Plant & Soil Science, Horticulture, Turf & Golf Course Mgt, Animal Science, and Agriculture Education.
WesternKentuckyUniversityDepartmentofAgr.name: Western Kentucky University Department of Agriculture & Food Science
